National Cooperative Smart Registry (NCSR)

A digital platform for cooperative registration, regulation, member management and cooperative identity services across Nigeria — built for societies, unions, federations and their members in every state.

Why NCSR

One national platform, replacing paper-based cooperative administration

NCSR brings registration, identity, governance and record-keeping into a single, auditable system shared by regulators and cooperators alike.

Digital Registration

End-to-end online registration with document upload, replacing physical form submission.

Secure Identity Verification

Every member and officer is verified against a secure national identity framework.

Cooperative Governance

Built-in compliance tools help regulators and executives govern by the Cooperative Societies Act.

National Registry

A single source of truth for every registered cooperative across all 36 states and the FCT.

Certificate Issuance

Digitally signed, instantly verifiable certificates of registration and good standing.

Digital Member Management

Cooperative officers manage rosters, dues and elections directly from their dashboard.

Frequently Asked Questions

Common questions about NCSR

Any group of Nigerians forming a primary cooperative, union, federation or apex body under the Cooperative Societies Act may apply, provided they meet the minimum membership and documentation requirements for their state.

Most complete applications are reviewed within 10–15 working days. You can track progress at any time using the reference number issued at submission.

Yes. Use "Search / Reserve Cooperative Name" to check availability against the national database and hold your preferred name for 60 days while you complete your application.

Enter the certificate number shown on the document into the "Verify a Certificate" service. The system will confirm its authenticity and current status instantly.

Yes. NCSR uses secure identity verification and encrypted records in line with federal data protection requirements, and access is limited to authorised officers and regulators.

Reach the NCSR Help Desk through the Contact & Support section below, or visit your State Cooperative Office for in-person assistance.
